items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Universal music featurette with Ella Mae Morse, the Lancers, Tex Williams, Alfan Copeland

ctx.x: Well, you couldn't. That's why I disbanded the band and came out to California. Then when I'd get a call I'd grab a train and go back to New York, because I didn't change my -- I didn't want to change my -- well, I figured if I got inducted out in California I'd be sent to the Pacific, and I didn't dig that too much.
Uh-uh. Uh-uh. 'Record Shop,' 1957, 15 minutes. Universal music featurette with Ella Mae Morse, the Lancers, Tex Williams, Alfan Copeland, plus Charlie Barnet and His Orchestra. Remember that?
That was one of those short subjects.
